source.normalization: The repository copy preserves the attachment content and has one final LF added by patch transport.

priorities.name: Baseline, truth layers, regression, safety and evidence integrity
LF-001 vehicle-entry production: APPROACH through DOOR_CLOSE
Real repair and re-anchor with bounded lineage
LF-002 dialogue, voice, performance, lip-sync and audio
LF-003 Scene Bible, dependent long form and editorial assembly
Architecture, cohesion, progressive disclosure and maturity

criteria.acceptance: Fresh audit covers repository, code, profiles, tests, docs, verification, artifacts, ComfyUI, queue, GPUs, VRAM, models, workflow hashes, distribution and critics.
Intent, canonical plan/state, prompt compiler output, runtime attempt, generated bytes and observations are separate, linked and append-only.
Capability matrix uses only the six allowed states and distinguishes structural, runtime, artifact, multi-shot and production evidence.
Full regression gate includes tests, compileall, Skill validation, docs/schema, manifest, external-CWD smoke, import DAG/cycles and privacy/security scans.
Every real POST has selected device, observed free VRAM, floor, margin, queue ownership and profile/workflow/model/node hashes; unrelated jobs are untouched.
Failures, OOM, partial outputs, unknown outcomes and repair attempts are retained and never promoted without the required oracle.
LF-001 executes the chain APPROACH, PRE_CONTACT, HANDLE_CONTACT, DOOR_OPEN, BODY_ORIENTATION, ENTRY, SEATED_STATE, DOOR_CLOSE with shot contracts and state locks.
LF-001 has distinct real artifacts, hashes, semantic observations, 13-dimension continuity, adjacent transition QA, real assembly and editorial status.
Natural failure repair follows DETECT, LOCALIZE, OWNER, MINIMAL_CHANGE, NEW_ATTEMPT, REOBSERVE, TRANSITION_REVALIDATION and REASSEMBLY.
FLF modes are independently exercised and endpoint artifacts are inspected; unrun modes remain UNKNOWN/NOT_RUN.
LF-002 separates SCRIPT, VOICE, VISUAL PERFORMANCE, LIP_SYNC, FOLEY, AMBIENCE, MIX and ASSEMBLY, with causality and audio dimensions.
LF-003 includes Scene Bible, timeline, 6-12 dependent shots, continuity ledger, audio, transitions, repairs, assembly and editorial review.
A second real adapter is tested differentially against the same canonical scene without large downloads or invented capability.
Ownership boundaries, deterministic-vs-agent judgment, progressive disclosure, compact SKILL, tests, known-bad cases and maturity levels are explicit.
Fresh critic is non-inherited, read-only, reviewer-owned and records fingerprint before/after, criteria matrix, severity/evidence, mutation sentinel and PASS/REJECT/INCOMPLETE.
Final distribution is frozen after critic and includes CRC/SHA, manifest, security scans, compile, Skill validation, external-CWD smoke and final fingerprint.

proven_requires: accepted real LF-001, LF-002 and LF-003
